levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Adult confirms fewer than three of the learner's flagged items as real hazards.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Adult confirms at least four real hazards across two categories.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Adult confirms at least four hazards across three or more categories, and the learner self-corrects a false flag.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Cannot name the hazard category or propose a workable fix.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Names the correct category and proposes a workable fix for each confirmed hazard.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Proposed fixes address the root cause, not just the immediate symptom (for example securing a shelf instead of just moving items off it).

lookFors: Adult was present for the full walk-through, not just a summary afterward.
Learner did not attempt any hazard fix without adult review first.
Findings distinguish clutter from genuine hazard.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
